title: Fix admin authorization for addCommentList (Create Comment List)

requirements.text: Fix the backend authorization check for the `addCommentList` (Create Comment List) function in backend/main.mo so that it correctly recognizes the admin caller and allows comment list creation. The current error is 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists'. Apply the same admin principal check fix that was used to resolve the Live List and Settings authorization issues — ensure the admin identity/principal check is consistent across all admin-gated functions.

quotes: Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists

acceptanceCriteria: Calling `addCommentList` from the Admin Panel no longer returns 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists'
A new comment list can be created successfully from AdminComments.tsx using the authenticated admin actor
The authorization check in `addCommentList` uses the same admin principal check pattern as other fixed admin-gated functions (e.g., addAppEvent, setAccessKey)
Other admin-gated functions are not broken by this change

requirements.text: Fix the frontend actor construction in AdminComments.tsx so that all mutation calls (createCommentList, renameCommentList, deleteCommentList, addTemplatesToList, etc.) use the authenticated admin actor rather than the anonymous identity, consistent with the fix applied to AdminLiveList.tsx and AdminSettings.tsx.

quotes: Unauthorized: Only admins can add comment lists

acceptanceCriteria: AdminComments.tsx retrieves and uses the authenticated actor for all mutation calls
Creating, renaming, deleting, and modifying comment lists from the Admin Panel completes without authorization errors
The pattern matches how AdminLiveList.tsx and AdminSettings.tsx obtain and pass the authenticated actor

constraints: Do not change any existing comment list UI layout or behavior beyond what is needed to fix the authorization error
The admin principal check fix must be consistent with the pattern already applied to Live List and Settings authorization fixes
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths
nonGoals: Changing the comment list data model
Modifying other admin tabs beyond AdminComments.tsx
